records.text: Johnnie Moore said he was involved with the Anti-Defamation League in multiple ways and served on an Aspen Institute–ADL civil-society fellowship advisory board.
records.speaker: Johnnie Moore

appearances.snippet: I'm involved in the ADL in all kinds of ways, you know, I'm a part of the ADL and Aspen Institute's civil society fellowship, you know, I'm on the advisory board for the Aspen Institute and ADL's civil society fellowship.

verification.notes: The primary clip records Moore describing his ADL involvement, and Aspen’s 2019 announcement names him to the ADL–Aspen Civil Society Fellowship advisory committee. Current ADL materials also list him on its board.
